s.note: Skewered shrimp brushed with smoked paprika garlic butter, lemon to squeeze.
s.how: Thread 600g peeled green prawns onto skewers. Brush with 60g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of cayenne. Grill 2 minutes a side and squeeze lemon over.

m.note: Dark roux gumbo with smoked sausage, vegetables and shrimp.
m.how: Stir 80ml oil and 80g flour over medium heat for 30 minutes into a dark roux. Add an onion, 2 celery sticks and a capsicum, then garlic, 1L stock and 250g sliced smoked sausage. Simmer an hour, add 500g prawns for 3 minutes. Serve over 300g rice.

w.note: Cinnamon peaches under a soft biscuit topping, with vanilla ice cream.
w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

w.note: Handmade dark chocolates filled with caramel, raspberry ganache or peanut butter.
w.how: Paint chocolate moulds with 250g melted dark chocolate and set. Fill some with caramel melted with a little cream, some with raspberry ganache and some with peanut butter. Seal with more chocolate, set and mix them up in a box.

d.note: Dr Pepper poured over vanilla ice cream, one for each of the fifteen he drank at the White House.
d.how: A Dr Pepper float. Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour a 375ml can of cold Dr Pepper slowly down the side of each glass so it foams up without spilling. Top with a maraschino cherry and serve with a straw and a long spoon.
